# Appeal of Denial — ACL Reconstruction (CPT 29888)

**Member:** Rowan Ellison
**Member ID:** W486282210
**Payer/Plan:** Ambetter (WellCare), Commercial/ACA, North Carolina
**Denial date:** 2026-08-17
**Reference number:** POC-5D5B151DE3-65694

**Governing policy:** No specific medical policy title, number, or URL was identified in the denial notice I received. As noted below, I understand that musculoskeletal surgery reviews for this plan are delegated to TurningPoint, and I am requesting the specific criteria that were applied to my case.

---

Dear Appeals Reviewer,

I am appealing the denial of my prior authorization request for ACL reconstruction (CPT 29888), referenced above. My surgeon, Dr. Okafor, has documented that this procedure is medically necessary, and I am asking the plan to reconsider its decision.

## Why I am appealing

The denial states that "the clinical records submitted do not document an adequate trial of conservative treatment prior to the requested surgery." I want to walk through what my records actually show, because I believe this reflects the treatment I have already completed.

**The plan's specific criteria have not been quoted to me.** The denial notice references "the plan's applicable medical policy and clinical review criteria" but does not tell me, in writing, what those criteria are or how my records failed to meet them. I am not able to respond point-by-point to standards I have not seen. I am formally requesting that the plan provide, in writing, the specific clinical criteria applied to this denial. I understand that musculoskeletal surgery review for this plan is delegated to TurningPoint, and that TurningPoint's criteria are not publicly published; their site instructs members or providers to submit a contact form naming the health plan to obtain the applicable policy. I am asking that this be done and that the criteria be sent to me directly as part of this appeal.

**What my records show regarding conservative treatment:**

- I experienced 14 months of progressive knee pain that did not improve with rest.
- I completed 14 weeks of supervised physical therapy (2026-03-27 to 2026-07-03), totaling 20 visits, focused on range of motion and quadriceps strengthening, along with bracing. This is documented in my physical therapy discharge note.
- I used NSAIDs for 8 months without adequate relief.
- I received a corticosteroid injection on 2026-05-28, which gave only two weeks of partial relief.
- An MRI on 2026-07-01 showed a complete mid-substance tear of the ACL with an associated bone bruise pattern. The menisci were intact and there was no significant arthritis.
- I continue to experience recurrent instability with pivoting and have had my knee give way twice on stairs.
- On examination, I have positive provocative testing on the affected side and limited range of motion due to pain.
- I have no active infection, no untreated substance use, a BMI of 29, and I do not smoke.

Given this history — over a year of symptoms, a full course of supervised physical therapy, prolonged NSAID use, and an injection that provided only brief relief, all in the setting of a confirmed complete ACL tear with ongoing instability — I do not believe it is accurate to say that conservative treatment was not adequately tried. I am asking the plan to review this history against its own criteria, once those criteria are provided to me, and to explain specifically which element it believes is missing.

## What I am requesting

1. That the plan reverse its denial and approve the requested ACL reconstruction (CPT 29888), or
2. If the plan maintains its denial, that it provide me in writing the specific clinical criteria used in this determination, including the source document (e.g., TurningPoint criteria) and the specific requirement my records did not meet.

## Deadline and submission

I understand this appeal must be received by **2027-02-13**. I am submitting it through the appeal address printed on my denial notice, and I understand I may also file through ambetterhealth.com by selecting my state and using that state's appeal or grievance form, or by calling the number on my member ID card.

Please let me know if any additional information is needed from me or from Dr. Okafor's office to complete this review.

Thank you for your time and attention to this appeal.

Sincerely,

[Signature]
Rowan Ellison
Member ID: W486282210
[Date]
[Contact phone number]
[Contact address]

---

*This letter is not medical or legal advice and does not guarantee that coverage will be approved.*
